facts.statement: Plourdosteus was a small, extinct arthrodire placoderm that lived in Euramerica during the Givetian and Frasnian stages of the Devonian.
facts.quote: Plourdosteus is an extinct genus of placoderm arthrodire which was relatively widespread in Euramerica during the Givetian to Frasnian ages of the Devonian.

facts.statement: A specimen of Plourdosteus canadensis measured 37.5 centimeters in length.
facts.quote: It was a small placoderm, with P. canadensis specimen MNHM 2-177 measuring 37.5 cm long.

facts.statement: The genus Plourdosteus was described by Ørvig in 1951.
Four species have been assigned to the genus: P. canadensis (Woodward, 1892), P. livonicus (Eastman, 1896), P. mironovi (Obruchev, 1933), and P. trautscholdi (Eastman, 1897).
facts.quote: subdivision: Plourdosteus canadensis (Woodward, 1892) Plourdosteus livonicus (Eastman, 1896) Plourdosteus mironovi (Obruchev, 1933) Plourdosteus trautscholdi (Eastman, 1897)

facts.statement: The name Plourdosteus honors the Plourde family associated with Miguasha National Park.
facts.quote: The name Plourdosteus commemorates the Plourde family at Miguasha National Park.

facts.statement: Plourdosteus was originally placed in the family Plourdosteidae, but this family was later deemed polyphyletic and discarded.
facts.quote: Plourdosteus was previously assigned to the family Plourdosteidae within the Coccosteomorphi. However, subsequent studies found the family Plourdosteidae to be polyphyletic and should be dismissed.

facts.statement: Plourdosteus is now classified as a member of the family Panxiosteidae.
facts.quote: Plourdosteus was then proposed to be a member of Panxiosteidae.

facts.statement: A 2010 study identified Panxiosteidae as the sister group to Dunkleosteidae, forming the superfamily Dunkleosteoidea.
facts.quote: In the 2010 Carr & Hlavin phylogenetic study, Panxiosteidae was recognized as the sister taxon to the family Dunkleosteidae, which together comprised the superfamily Dunkleosteoidea (one of the three major clades of Eubrachythoraci).

facts.statement: A 2016 study placed Panxiosteidae outside Dunkleosteoidea, instead as a sister group to Coccosteidae within the superfamily Coccosteoidea.
facts.quote: However, the subsequent 2016 Zhu et al. study using a larger morphological dataset recovered Panxiosteidae well outside of Dunkleosteoidea, instead within Coccosteomorphi and then Coccosteoidea as the sister group of Coccosteidae, as shown in the cladogram below:

facts.statement: Plourdosteus lived between 387.95 and 372.15 million years ago during the Givetian to Frasnian periods.
facts.quote: Time range: Givetian to Frasnian (387.95 to 372.15 million years ago)

facts.statement: There are 17 recorded fossil occurrences of Plourdosteus in the Paleobiology Database.
